scope: Wiring existing implemented ports only; future component algorithms unchanged

requirements.statement: Compose the existing owner ports and configured model roles with explicit workspace/identity boundaries.
Return attributed native results and retained candidates to subsequent bounded reasoning context.
Export/import same-cut selective teacher critique and resume a student revision without teacher admission authority.
Distinguish definite output rejection, pending external input and unknown provider completion; retain costs and bound correction.
Preserve prior failures and report build/contract status separately from runtime and scientific qualification.

cases.acceptance: Native acquisition, interpretation, candidate retention and later native retrieval are selected through C0 with actual provenance.
Supported C5 artifacts and eligible C6 assessment results reach the next inference without a direct C4-C5 lane or generated evidence promotion.
Exported teacher cut/attempt/images remain original; imported critique is generated; student revision and its candidates are retained; unknown usage stays explicit.
Shape/semantic rejection retains original bytes and diagnostics, dispatches no proposed action, charges usage and permits only a distinct bounded correction job.
Unknown provider completion or usage disagreement is not redispatched on resume/crash; known cached completion remains reusable.
Model-generated component calls cannot request operator admission/adoption/reconciliation, fabricate workspace/request authority or label C2 assistance as operator-authored.
Repeated bad output, finite budgets, teacher waiting and native-tool errors retain state/cost and resume/yield according to the explicit phase contract.
A valid response with no investigation/final report remains yielded/unsolved; no source check or teacher agreement is reported as problem-solving success.
